rows.jp: 「……これで……許されるんですか？」

ghs.en: Misato: "...and with this... will I be forgiven?"

rows.jp: ブラウスのボタンをとめて、先輩は言った。
rows.en: Mimi spoke as she buttoned her blouse.

ghs.en: So said Senpai, fixing back the buttons of her blouse.

rows.jp: ひどく沈んでいる。

ghs.en: She is horribly depressed.

rows.jp: 原因は……いじわるしたから、ではないだろう。
rows.en: It probably wasn’t because I had been cruel to her.

ghs.en: The cause is... not the teasing, I expect.

rows.jp: 彼女は知っているだけだ。

ghs.en: It's just that she knows.

rows.jp: そぐわない罰を受けても、罪は解決しないことを。
rows.en: A punishment that did not fit the crime could never make the sin go away.

ghs.en: Accepting an unsuitable punishment is not the resolution of a sin.

rows.jp: いや、そもそも―――

ghs.en: No, from the very start this---

rows.jp: 「わたしは……これで……許されるんですか……？」

ghs.en: Misato: "Will I... with this... be forgiven...?"

rows.jp: 「罪は決して許されませんよ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "No sin can ever be tolerated."

rows.jp: 海を眺めつつ、砂を蹴る。
rows.en: Gazing out at the sea, I kicked the sand.

ghs.en: I kick sand while gazing, lost, at the sea.

rows.jp: 透き通った砂子が扇状に舞った。
rows.en: Translucent grains of sand fanned through the air.

ghs.en: The sand fluttered in a fan shape, becoming translucent.

rows.jp: 「じゃあ……どうしようも、ないんですね……」

ghs.en: Misato: "Then... whatever I do, I never will..."

rows.jp: 短くない沈黙を挟んで、陰気な声。
rows.en: A long silence passed before she answered, her voice dark.

ghs.en: A melancholic voice is squeezed between her non-short silences.
Taichi: "..."

rows.jp: 俺がもう少しマシな人間なら、励ますこともできた。
rows.en: If I had been even a little better as a person, I might have encouraged her.

ghs.en: If I were just a little less objectionable a human, I would have been capable of cheering her up.

rows.jp: 己の思索に対し、誠実さのない論拠をうちたてて。
rows.en: I could have invented some argument I didn’t believe in to contradict my own conclusion.

ghs.en: Formulating an argument devoid of honesty that would contrast her self-contemplation.

rows.jp: けど俺にはできない。

ghs.en: But I can't do it.

rows.jp: どうしようもない。
rows.en: There was nothing to be done.

ghs.en: Whatever you do, indeed.

rows.jp: まさにそれこそが真実だと、確信していたから。
rows.en: Because I was convinced this was the plain truth.

ghs.en: That is the certain truth, and because I so believed,

rows.jp: 沈黙が意図を伝えた。

ghs.en: the silence conveyed the intention.

rows.jp: 「……うう……ううううう……」

ghs.en: Misato: "...uuh... nggggh..."

rows.jp: 慰める術はなかった。
rows.en: I knew no way to comfort her.

ghs.en: There were no means to console her.

rows.jp: 少し調子に乗りすぎた。
rows.en: I had let myself get carried away.

ghs.en: I got carried away by the moment a little too much.

rows.jp: 先輩をいじめてしまった。
rows.en: I had been cruel to Mimi.

ghs.en: I ended up bullying Senpai.

rows.jp: ハッピーエンドに。
rows.en: I had meant to lead her to a happy ending.

ghs.en: Even though, in a Happy Ending,

rows.jp: 美しいトラウマのカウンセリングを、するはずだったのに。
rows.en: I had meant to provide elegant counseling for a beautiful trauma.

ghs.en: there would certainly be a beautiful Trauma Counseling here.

rows.jp: 「……難しい」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...so difficult."

rows.jp: 顔を覆う。

ghs.en: I covered my face.

rows.jp: 失敗したことを、悟った。
rows.en: I understood that I had failed.

ghs.en: I realized that I had failed.

rows.jp: 「親しき仲にはあだ名あり、です」

ghs.en: Misato: "There are always informal names between close friends."
Taichi: "Huh..."

rows.jp: 「お互いニックネームを決めましょう」

ghs.en: Misato: "Let us decide nicknames for each other!"

rows.jp: ニュアンスとしてはペットネーム、という気もした。
rows.en: It felt less like a nickname than a *pet name*.

ghs.en: There was this feeling that the nuance was closer to "pet's name", too.

rows.jp: ペットみたいに気に入られているのは間違いない。
rows.en: She was certainly fond of me, if only as a pet.

ghs.en: I am like a pet to her, no mistake.

rows.jp: どちらにしても。

ghs.en: Regardless,

rows.jp: 彼女の笑顔の下に、親愛があるかどうかはわからないのだ。
rows.en: I had no idea whether there was any affection beneath her smile.

ghs.en: since I didn't understand whether or not there was actual affection under her smile,

rows.jp: 俺はまだ警戒をしていた。

ghs.en: I was still vigilant.

rows.jp: 「じゃ……先輩」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Then... Senpai."

rows.jp: 考えた結果、提案できたのはその呼び方だった。
rows.en: After considerable thought, that was all I could offer.

ghs.en: The result of my considerations allowed me to suggest that appellation.

rows.jp: 「先輩だけじゃ区別つかないでしょう？」
rows.en: “That won’t distinguish me from anyone else.”

ghs.en: Misato: "With just Senpai there is no actual telling me apart, is there?"

rows.jp: 「……合理的じゃないですね。宮澄先輩でいいじゃないですか」
rows.en: “...Fair point. I could just call you Miyasumi.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...that is just irrational. Is Miyasumi-senpai not good enough?"

rows.jp: 「うーん、黒須太一……ですから」

ghs.en: Misato: "Hmmm, Kurosu Taichi... let me see."

rows.jp: 聞いてなかった。

ghs.en: She didn't listen.

rows.jp: 「たいち君、はつまらないですよね」
rows.en: “Plain old Taichi is too boring, don’t you think?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Taichi-kun is just boring, yes it is."

rows.jp: 「つまらないって、あんた……人の名前を……」
rows.en: “Dull? That’s my name you’re talking about...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Boring, really now... that's somebody's name, dammit..."

rows.jp: 何げに辛辣だな。

ghs.en: Just casually sharp-tongued.

rows.jp: 「……黒須……黒須……ばってん……ばってん！」

ghs.en: Misato: "...Kurosu... Cross... cross mark... demerit mark, Batten!"

rows.jp: 「……却下させてくださいお願いします」
rows.en: “...Please let me veto that. I’m begging you.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...I would like to veto that, if I please could."

rows.jp: 頭を下げた。

ghs.en: I bowed my head.

rows.jp: 「えー！」

ghs.en: Misato: "Awww!"

rows.jp: 「そんな方言みたいな呼ばれ方はゴメンです」
rows.en: “I refuse to be named after a pirate flag.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "I would apologetically decline being called in a way that sounds so dialectal."

rows.jp: 「じゃあ……ばつ……ぺけ……」

ghs.en: Misato: "Then... cross mark... in Kanto that is Peke..."

rows.jp: 「……ぺけくん？」

ghs.en: Misato: "...Peke-kun?"

rows.jp: 「また間抜けな響きを醸しだしてくれましたね」
rows.en: “You’ve managed to make it sound even more idiotic.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "You have brewed up another thing that sounds moronic."

rows.jp: 「あ、でもいい感じ。わたしは気に入りましたよ」
rows.en: “Oh, but I like it. It feels right.”

ghs.en: Misato: "Ah, but it feels right. I am very pleased with it!"

rows.jp: ぺけだと？

ghs.en: With 'peke'?

rows.jp: 基本の思考に『×』があるのだった。
rows.en: An X lay at the very foundation of my thinking.

ghs.en: Seems "X" was at the base of her thinking.

rows.jp: 「よく考えたら……ペケってダメって意味じゃないですか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Thinking about it... does Peke not just evoke worthlessness?"

rows.jp: 「Ｘという意味もあったりなかったり」
rows.en: “It may or may not also mean X.”

ghs.en: Misato: "And it could also mean X as in 'combining'."

rows.jp: 「ぺけという記号は、交差しあってるんです」
rows.en: “An X is made of two crossing lines.”

ghs.en: Misato: "The notation of 'peke', X, means crossing."

rows.jp: 「……支え合ってさえいない」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...without so much as reciprocal support, like that thing they say about the Person kanji. It's just piercing through."

rows.jp: 寒々しかった。

ghs.en: That was so dreary.

rows.jp: 「すれ違いって意味にしか受け取れないんですけど……」
rows.en: “All I see is two people passing each other by...”

ghs.en: Taichi: "But what I get is nothing but the meaning of paths that cross but never meet..."

rows.jp: 「世間から弾かれたわたしたちも、いつか誰かと交差できるといいなという願いがこめられてます」
rows.en: “It carries our hope that those of us cast out by society may someday cross paths with someone.”

ghs.en: Misato: "It also contains the desire that even us, rejected by the world, have of someday finding our crossing with someone."

rows.jp: 「……偽善的だ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...hypocritical."

rows.jp: そして無理矢理だ。
rows.en: And one hell of a stretch.

ghs.en: And furthermore, forced.

rows.jp: 「さあ、こっちは決まりましたよ。そっちの番です」
rows.en: “There. Yours is decided. Now it’s your turn.”

ghs.en: Misato: "So, I have decided on my side. It is your turn now."

rows.jp: 決まってしまった。
rows.en: And just like that, it was decided.

ghs.en: Decided she has, dammit.

rows.jp: 「はぁ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Sigh..."

rows.jp: こうなったら、つきあうしかないのだった。
rows.en: I had no choice but to play along.

ghs.en: With things ending up like this, I had nothing to do but keep her company.

rows.jp: 彼女との短いつきあいでも、よく理解できていた。
rows.en: Even in the short time I had known her, I understood that much.

ghs.en: I haven't been around her but for a short time, and yet this I knew well.

rows.jp: 「じゃ……雌奴隷」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Then... she-slave."

rows.jp: 「この法治国家日本で奴隷なんていませんし」
rows.en: “There are no slaves in Japan, a nation governed by law.”

ghs.en: Misato: "There is no slavery within the Constitutional State of Japan."

rows.jp: 「愛奴隷」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Love Slave."

rows.jp: 「どう違うんですか！」

ghs.en: Misato: "How is that even different!"

rows.jp: 「雌豚先輩？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Senior Sow?"

rows.jp: 「……そのめすぶたの後輩になるんですよ、いいんですか？」
rows.en: “...You’d be that sow’s junior. Are you sure you want that?”

ghs.en: Misato: "...you want to become the Kouhai of a female pig, are you fine with that?"

rows.jp: 「おっぱいさん」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Oppai-san."

rows.jp: 「そ、そういう目でわたしの胸を……」
rows.en: “Y-you’ve been looking at my chest that way...?”

ghs.en: Misato: "Th-, that kind of eyes on my chest..."

rows.jp: 「搾乳隷奴」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Cowmilking evalS."

rows.jp: 「ひっくり返す意味がわかりませんです……」
rows.en: “I don’t understand what spelling it backward accomplished...”

ghs.en: Misato: "I do not understand the point of saying that backwards..."

rows.jp: 「おっぱいから離れませんか？」

ghs.en: Misato: "Shall we distance ourselves from 'boobs'?"

rows.jp: 注文が多い。

ghs.en: So many requests.

rows.jp: 「……エロメガネさん」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...eromegane-san."

rows.jp: 「拒否」

ghs.en: Misato: "Denied."

rows.jp: 「全部拒絶じゃないですか！」

ghs.en: Taichi: "You are just denying all of them!"

rows.jp: 叫ぶ。

ghs.en: I shout.

rows.jp: クールな俺だけでは、対応できない。
rows.en: My cool-guy act wasn’t enough to handle her.

ghs.en: I can't manage this by staying my cool self.

rows.jp: 「あなたがヘンなのばっかり提案するからです！」
rows.en: “Because every name you suggest is bizarre!”

ghs.en: Misato: "Because you are making nothing but weird suggestions!"

rows.jp: 「じゃメガネ女！」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Then, Eyeglassed Female!"

rows.jp: 「見たままですね。捻りませんか？」
rows.en: “That’s merely a description. Can’t you give it a twist?”

ghs.en: Misato: "That is just what I look like. Is there no twist?"

rows.jp: 人をばってん呼ばわりしかけた女のセリフとしては完璧すぎた。
rows.en: Perfect, coming from the woman who had nearly named me Crossbones.

ghs.en: A line far too perfect for a female who about to give someone the name "demerit mark".
Taichi: "...Mimi."

rows.jp: 「それは？」

ghs.en: Misato: "Because?"

rows.jp: 「みやすみみさとで、みみ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "MiyasuMI MIsato, Mimi."

rows.jp: 「ああ、いい感じ」

ghs.en: Misato: "Ahhh, that seems nice!"

rows.jp: ふわりとほころぶ。
rows.en: Her face blossomed into a soft smile.

ghs.en: She softly breaks into a smile.

rows.jp: 頭悪く見えるほど、ゆるい笑い方。
rows.en: So loose and guileless it almost made her look dim.

ghs.en: She's as lax in the way she smiles as she looks slow in the head,

rows.jp: けど。

ghs.en: but.

rows.jp: ……妙に、面映ゆい。

ghs.en: ...there is an odd self-conscious embarrassment.

rows.jp: 「三つあるな。みみみ、か」

ghs.en: Taichi: "But there are three of them. Mimimi, then."

rows.jp: 「美々美とか書きますか？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Should be written 'beauty, kanji repetition, beauty' I think? Although it is usually pronounced Bibibi or Vivivi."

rows.jp: 「アホヒロインみたいな響きに……」
rows.en: “Now I sound like an airheaded heroine...”

ghs.en: Misato: "That sounds like it belongs to some dumb heroine..."

rows.jp: 俺みたいな危険人物に声をかけるアホな人ではあった。
rows.en: She was foolish enough to approach someone as dangerous as me.

ghs.en: Well, she was the kind of dumb person who would call out to a dangerous character like myself.

rows.jp: アホすぎて……ついつい、優しくしたくなる。
rows.en: So foolish that... I could not help wanting to be gentle with her.

ghs.en: Excessively dumb... so much that against my better judgment, I ended up wanting to be kind.

rows.jp: 「……みみ先輩」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...Mimi-senpai."

rows.jp: 「あ、それそれ、それがいいです」

ghs.en: Misato: "Ah, yes yes, that is good yes!"

rows.jp: 「そうですか」

ghs.en: Taichi: "So it is."

rows.jp: 「じゃこれで二人は先輩と後輩ですよ」

ghs.en: Misato: "And so with this the two of us are Senpai and Kouhai!"

rows.jp: 小指を出す。

ghs.en: She put out her pinky.

rows.jp: 違うと思ったが、応じた。指切り。
rows.en: I thought that was the wrong gesture, but linked mine with hers. A pinky promise.

ghs.en: This is wrong, I thought, but still responded. We linked pinkys.

rows.jp: 「どうせ、親しい名前をつけてこき使うんでしょ。奴隷制度とどう違うんだか」
rows.en: “You’re only giving me a friendly name so you can work me to death. How is this different from slavery?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "And by the way, you worked me like a mule to find you a intimate nickname. How is that different from actual slavery?"

rows.jp: 「愛ある強制労働ですよ」

ghs.en: Misato: "It is the coerced labor of love."

rows.jp: 「あ、もちろん友愛の方ですよ？」

ghs.en: Misato: "Ah, of course I mean the love of friends, right?"

rows.jp: 「どちらなりと」

ghs.en: Taichi: "Whatever you please."

rows.jp: 肩をすくめた。

ghs.en: I shrugged my shoulders.
